item.title: How To Take Neon Koi Lantern Photo In Disney Dreamlight Valley
item.description:
You need to get the Neon Koi Lantern from the Pop City Star Path rewards and take a picture to complete the duty in Disney Dreamlight Valley . While some tasks in the Star Path seem easy enough to complete, and you will know exactly what to do, some are a bit confusing. Recently, the Star Path duties have been asking players to buy something from the rewards tab to finish one or multiple tasks. Like how in Godly Glamour, Dreamers had to wear the Gladiator set to complete some routine duties. To fully finish the Pop City Star Path, here's how to Take Photo: Neon Koi Lantern in DDV .

How To Unlock Wreck It Ralph In Disney Dreamlight Valley (Continue? Quest)

Unlock Wreck It Ralph in Disney Dreamlight Valley by finding a glitchy arcade machine, removing cables, and feeding the machine special items.

By Nahda Nabiilah

How To Take Photo: Neon Koi Lantern In Disney Dreamlight Valley

To complete the Take Photo: Neon Koi Lantern duty in DDV , Dreamers need to buy the Neon Koi Lantern for 75 Tokens from the rewards' 6th page of the Pop City Star Path and snap a picture . It's not something your character can hold, but a piece of furniture. So place it somewhere in the valley or inside your home and take a photo. You can be in the photo or remove yourself completely, it depends on your preference. It doesn't matter as long as the Neon Koi Lantern is clear in the photo.

Completing the Take Photo: Neon Koi Lantern duty rewards 30 Tokens, which is a decent amount considering how simple, albeit confusing, the task is. This duty is very far away from the beginning of the Star Path. In fact, you will get it quite late. Meaning by the time this task appears, you will probably be on the final pages of the rewards tab. So, no need to worry about not being able to get the Neon Koi Lantern. Unless you purchased the premium version of the Pop City Star Path and you complete the rewards page by page.

For the sake of the Take Photo: Neon Koi Lantern duty, try to purchase three items from every page to quickly open the next one. This way, you reach page 6 quicker and the task doesn't stick around longer than usual, taking up a spot for another task you can complete immediately.

Once the Neon Koi Lantern is purchased, you can place it anywhere you want and buy as many lanterns as possible from the Scrooge McDuck store. The lantern also has a cool feature where you can interact with it to change colors.

Disney Dreamlight Valley

item.title: Mistfall Hunter: Best PC Settings for FPS & Performance
item.description:
Whether you're engaging in high-stakes PvP clashes or exploring dark dungeons, optimizing your experience with these best settings for Mistfall Hunter on PC is essential to surviving extractions without frustrating stuttering or lag.

Despite its striking dark fantasy visual style, the game can be quite demanding on hardware, often leading to sudden frame drops during intense combat. This optimization guide breaks down the best graphics settings for Mistfall Hunter to maximize your FPS, eliminate micro-stutters, and maintain rock-solid performance across both mid-range and high-end PC builds.

Can You Change FOV in Mistfall Hunter?

Wondering if you can change the FOV in Mistfall Hunter? Here is everything you need to know about in-game slider options and camera settings.

By Ayyoun Ali

Best Graphics Settings for Mistfall Hunter on PC (Optimization)

To maintain a rock-solid framerate during Mistfall Hunter's PvPvE encounters while keeping distant players and extraction points visible, you need to balance visual fidelity against raw performance. Heavily taxing features like Ray Tracing, Global Illumination, and Shadow Quality will severely bottleneck your GPU and cause frame drops during chaotic fights.

Here are the optimized graphics settings for Mistfall Hunter on PC that you can use to get maximum FPS.

Type

Graphics Options

Best Settings

Notes

Display Settings

Window Mode

Borderless Window

-

Resolution

Native

Anything lower makes textures blurry.

Frame Rate Limit

Unlimited

No need to cap your FPS as the game features both PvE and PvP combat encounters.

Graphics Settings

Antialiasing Type

Nvidia DLSS or AMD FSR

Use either of the two AI upscalers by Nvidia or AMD to get the best performance in Mistfall Hunter , while improving texture clarity.

DLSS Mode

Balanced

Balanced scales your internal resolution to 50% and upscales it to your native res. This gives you significant performance back and eliminates stuttering in Mistfall Hunter .

DLSS Frame Generation

2x

Nvidia RTX 40-series or above GPU players can enable Frame Generation, which gives them a massive FPS boost. It's recommended not to exceed 2x to avoid increased input latency.

Ray Tracing

Off

Ray Tracing is one of the most taxing settings in Mistfall Hunter , and one of the best settings to disable to gain high FPS. For players with high-end PCs, they can enable it for non-combat scenes only.

Shadow Quality

Low

Vastly improves FPS and makes enemies hiding in dark corners easier to spot.

View Distance

High or Epic

Ensures enemy models and extraction icons render clearly at long ranges.

Character Animation Quality

Performance

Prevents CPU frametime spikes when multiple players or large monster groups are on the screen.

Texture Quality

GPU VRAM Dependent

6GB VRAM : Medium, 8GB VRAM : High, 12GB+ VRAM : Epic

SFX Quality

Medium

Stops sudden lag hitches during heavy spell casts, AOE abilities, and boss encounters.

Post-Processing

Low

While it doesn't impact FPS much, reducing it to low will reduce unwanted visual clutter, lens effects, and depth-of-field blur in Mistfall Hunter .

Motion Blur

Off

Eliminates camera smear during fast turns and reduces motion sickness.

Global Illumination

Low or Medium

Heavy lighting calculations tank performance in outdoor areas when maxed out. It's another great setting for Mistfall Hunter that you can reduce to optimize performance.

These are the best settings for Mistfall Hunter on PC that can significantly optimize the game and improve FPS for players. The optimized settings above were tested on a PC with an Intel i9-14900HX CPU, an Nvidia RTX 4080 GPU, and 32 GB of RAM. The FPS averaged around 140, with 1% lows hovering around 105 , which is pretty great.

item.title: PlayStation Plus Subscribers Can Claim a Bonus Freebie Beginning August 6
item.description:
PlayStation Plus is having an incredibly busy end of July 2026/beginning of August 2026, adding its final PS Plus Extra games for July and announcing its first PS Plus free games for August 2026, but it has also confirmed a special bonus freebie for a brand new game on August 6. What's more, it'll be available to all PS Plus subscribers regardless of which tier they are subscribed to: Essential, Extra, and/or Premium.

Right now, Extra and Premium subscribers can also claim the latest addition to the PS Plus July 2026 games catalog: Dying Light, Snow Bros. Wonderland, Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector , and Mighty Morphin Power Rangers . PS Plus Essential subscribers (and higher tiers, of course) will also be able to claim Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Reloaded Edition, Big Walk , and Signalis as the monthly free games on August 4. And then, on August 6, there's a bonus freebie for a brand-new Marvel game, too.

PS Plus Extra Survival Game Gets a Massive Update

An upcoming PlayStation Plus Extra survival game releases a brand new and massive update that foreshadows the depth of content coming to the service.

By Joshua Duckworth

PS Plus Subscribers Get Bonus Freebies for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls

Announced alongside the PS Plus free games for August 2026 is the Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls PlayStation Plus Pack, a bonus freebie that can be claimed beginning August 6, 2026, and that will last until August 6, 2027. This is obviously in celebration of Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls ' release on PS5 the same day, August 6, and includes two sets of special items:

  • Five Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Avatars—Captain America, Storm, Spider-Man, Doctor Doom, and Ghost Rider
  • A Set of Result Screen Character Poses featuring 20 characters—Spider-Man, Ms. Marvel, Star-Lord, Peni Parker, and more

While it is a small freebie overall, it's worth mentioning that it's widely and easily available for PS Plus subscribers. Anyone playing Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls on PS5 is going to need PS Plus Essential to play online, and so it seems safe to say that most Marvel Tokon players are at least going to have that tier. So, it's a special little bonus for everyone choosing to play the newest fighting game on PS Plus.

Claiming these special items is also as simple as they are. While it's possible to claim them via the PS Plus website, they'll also populate on the PlayStation Plus section of the PlayStation Store. Players will be able to access it there, redeem it there, and directly download its contents. The Avatars will then appear in the Avatar section of the profile page, while the Result Screen Character Poses will be accessible in-game immediately after downloading.

Some Halo: Campaign Evolved Players Have Limited Time to Get Special Freebie

The upcoming fighting game obviously has a lot of hype around it, so fans should be sure to mark August 6 on their calendar and also keep this freebie in mind when they sit down to play the game. At the same time, Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls isn't just releasing and calling itself a one-and-done. Already, Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls has confirmed that Phoenix Cyclops is coming in its DLC line-up, setting a strong precedent for its DLC roster.

Source: PlayStation Blog

item.title: 5 Forgotten Open-World Games That Are Perfect From Start To Finish
item.description:
At some point during the late 2010s, open-world games started to lose their luster due to overexposure and overreliance on formulas. While a forever fixture in the gaming landscape, the genre doesn't receive as many experimental mid-budget projects anymore, instead existing solely in the AAA or indie sphere. If you are like me and have a deep fondness for open-world games from yesteryear, then you should 100% dive into the gems that aren't really talked about anymore.

A perfect game doesn't exist, but that isn't exactly what we are talking about. My definition of a "perfect" campaign is consistency; the game starts great, continues great, and ends great, with a few great distractions along the way. An open-world game that delivers a reliable 8/10 is better than a title that jumps between a 10/10 and a 5/10. These games understood that.

"Forgotten" is, obviously, hyperbole, as I'm sure plenty of folks remember these titles. However, they don't really get discussed anymore and might be completely new names for younger gamers.

Sleeping Dogs Tells An Incredible Crime Story

A PS3-Era Open-World Masterpiece

  • Perfect for approximately 20 hours.
  • Pretty good DLC expansions, particularly Zodiac Tournament.
  • Definitive Edition regularly goes on sale for just $2.99 on PC.

I'm always a bit hesitant to replay my favorite games from the PS2 and PS3 eras, as I'd rather leave the memories alone than spoil them with a subpar second run. However, Sleeping Dogs ' PC version is permanently on sale for less than the price of a coffee, and I just couldn't resist the urge to return to Hong Kong any longer.

7 Best Open-World Games Set In The Modern Day, Ranked

Prior to GTA 6, these are the best open-world games with modern explorable maps available today.

By Vlad Mazanko

Sadly, the combat didn't quite live up to my rose-tinted recollection, as it is merely good rather than great; however, everything else is even better than I remember. Sleeping Dogs is one of the best open-world games of the 2010s , and one of the most complete. You get a fantastic story with a likable and complex protagonist, an impressive urban open world that is the perfect size, solid police mission side quests that add to the main plot, and rock-solid driving mechanics.

The main attraction is Wei Shen's intense-as-heck descent into Hong Kong's underworld, a narrative overflowing with suspense, twists, and memorable deaths. Sleeping Dogs is worth playing solely for the story, and everything else is a nice bonus.

The True Crime games deserve an honorary mention as well, although they haven't aged as well as Sleeping Dogs .

The Incredible Hulk: Ultimate Destruction Is Aggressively Fun

Sometimes You Just Want To Smash A City

  • Perfect for approximately 12 hours.
  • You smash buildings and cars. You know, Hulk things.

Full disclosure: I am a sucker for a Radical Entertainment open-world game. If I could justify it, I would include The Incredible Hulk: Ultimate Destruction , Scarface: The World is Yours , and Prototype in this article, with Prototype 2 earning an honorable mention. The developer had an amazing knack for creating games that embody chaos.

Prototype is my favorite game by Radical, but The Incredible Hulk: Ultimate Destruction is the most consistently brilliant , partly because it's simpler. Hulk's ability to jump over city blocks and sprint up buildings redefined open-world traversal at the time, and his skillset never, ever stops being fun.

The environments aren't the most detailed or complex by any means, but they serve their purpose of supplying you with makeshift weapons, allowing Hulk to smash together cars like DUI boxing gloves. The campaign follows a fairly linear structure and avoids any padding; meanwhile, the gameplay's creative tools and reliance on player-driven destruction keep things from feeling scripted.

Gravity Rush 2 Is Just An All-Around Masterpiece

The PlayStation Open-World Franchise That Should Have Become More

  • Perfect for approximately 30 hours.
  • Defying gravity.

They say "never say never," but I'm ready to call it: Gravity Rush is dead. Perhaps because it was associated with a perpetually declining console, Japan Studio's series struggled to make the jump from "beloved niche gem" to simply "beloved," despite both games being highly regarded.

The first Gravity Rush is at least remembered as a marquee PS Vita title, but the much-improved sequel's legacy is just that of a PS4 game that some people played. Nearly a decade after its release, Gravity Rush 2 has not lost a single shred of charm , with its cel-shaded visuals and vertical world-design aging extremely gracefully.

Jirga Para Lhao is a vibrant, distinct world designed perfectly to complement Kat's gravity manipulation. Falling up toward a floating slum or dropping thousands of feet down through layer after layer of the atmosphere captures a sense of wander that few games can match.

Ultimate Spider-Man Is The Most "Comic Book" Superhero Game Ever

Spider-Man And Venom Are Here For A Fun Time, Not A Long Time

  • Perfect for approximately 8 hours.
  • Must-play for fans of the Ultimate Spider-Man comic book.

My dream Spider-Man game would combine Insomniac's gameplay with Ultimate Spider-Man 's aesthetic and writing. While not the greatest superhero romp ever, Ultimate Spider-Man comes the closest to fully translating the comic book page into video game form , to the point of actually being semi-canonical.

Spider-Man: 5 Strongest Villains Comics Fans Have Never Heard Of, Ranked

Check out the most formidable Spider-Man villains from video games that comic enthusiasts may be unfamiliar with, ranked from weakest to most powerful

By Evan Regan

Written by Brian Michael Bendis and Mark Bagley, the story fit the Ultimate Spider-Man comic timeline pretty well during its initial release, and some of its ideas would be explored further in the "War of the Symbiotes" arc that would eventually follow. The game lets you control both Spidey and Venom, who have wildly different gameplay styles, with the symbiote being a proper brute designed to embrace chaos.

Look, Ultimate Spider-Man is way too short to be really described as a fantastic game, but it's an absolute blast while it lasts. The combat is basic but solid, the web-swinging is good but not quite on Spider-Man 2 's level, and the story is pretty great.

Lego City Undercover Is The Perfect GTA For Kids

Collect-A-Thon Done Right

  • Perfect for approximately 20 hours.
  • The second-best undercover cop story in this article, but it is closer than you would think.

Most open-world games are perfectly fine for children, but they are really designed with younger players in mind. As Grand Theft Auto is meant for older folks only (even if nobody sticks to that rule), the gaming world needs a family-friendly substitute that can prepare youngsters for San Andreas. Lego City Undercover is that game.

Honestly, labeling TT Fusion's open-world adventure as a "children's game" would be a disservice, as Lego City Undercover is for all ages . Everyone can enjoy its surprisingly gorgeous city, accessible puzzles, comedic tone, and unlockables. By the time it left the Wii U and debuted on popular systems, the game was very much old news, so it didn't quite get its full moment in the sun.

The main attraction is Wei Shen's intense-as-heck descent into Hong Kong's underworld, a narrative overflowing with suspense, twists, and memorable deaths. Sleeping Dogs is worth playing solely for the story, and everything else is a nice bonus.

The True Crime games deserve an honorary mention as well, although they haven't aged as well as Sleeping Dogs .

The Incredible Hulk: Ultimate Destruction Is Aggressively Fun

Sometimes You Just Want To Smash A City

  • Perfect for approximately 12 hours.
  • You smash buildings and cars. You know, Hulk things.

Full disclosure: I am a sucker for a Radical Entertainment open-world game. If I could justify it, I would include The Incredible Hulk: Ultimate Destruction , Scarface: The World is Yours , and Prototype in this article, with Prototype 2 earning an honorable mention. The developer had an amazing knack for creating games that embody chaos.

Prototype is my favorite game by Radical, but The Incredible Hulk: Ultimate Destruction is the most consistently brilliant , partly because it's simpler. Hulk's ability to jump over city blocks and sprint up buildings redefined open-world traversal at the time, and his skillset never, ever stops being fun.

The environments aren't the most detailed or complex by any means, but they serve their purpose of supplying you with makeshift weapons, allowing Hulk to smash together cars like DUI boxing gloves. The campaign follows a fairly linear structure and avoids any padding; meanwhile, the gameplay's creative tools and reliance on player-driven destruction keep things from feeling scripted.

Gravity Rush 2 Is Just An All-Around Masterpiece

The PlayStation Open-World Franchise That Should Have Become More

  • Perfect for approximately 30 hours.
  • Defying gravity.

They say "never say never," but I'm ready to call it: Gravity Rush is dead. Perhaps because it was associated with a perpetually declining console, Japan Studio's series struggled to make the jump from "beloved niche gem" to simply "beloved," despite both games being highly regarded.

The first Gravity Rush is at least remembered as a marquee PS Vita title, but the much-improved sequel's legacy is just that of a PS4 game that some people played. Nearly a decade after its release, Gravity Rush 2 has not lost a single shred of charm , with its cel-shaded visuals and vertical world-design aging extremely gracefully.

Jirga Para Lhao is a vibrant, distinct world designed perfectly to complement Kat's gravity manipulation. Falling up toward a floating slum or dropping thousands of feet down through layer after layer of the atmosphere captures a sense of wander that few games can match.

Ultimate Spider-Man Is The Most "Comic Book" Superhero Game Ever

Spider-Man And Venom Are Here For A Fun Time, Not A Long Time

  • Perfect for approximately 8 hours.
  • Must-play for fans of the Ultimate Spider-Man comic book.

My dream Spider-Man game would combine Insomniac's gameplay with Ultimate Spider-Man 's aesthetic and writing. While not the greatest superhero romp ever, Ultimate Spider-Man comes the closest to fully translating the comic book page into video game form , to the point of actually being semi-canonical.

Spider-Man: 5 Strongest Villains Comics Fans Have Never Heard Of, Ranked

Check out the most formidable Spider-Man villains from video games that comic enthusiasts may be unfamiliar with, ranked from weakest to most powerful

By Evan Regan

Written by Brian Michael Bendis and Mark Bagley, the story fit the Ultimate Spider-Man comic timeline pretty well during its initial release, and some of its ideas would be explored further in the "War of the Symbiotes" arc that would eventually follow. The game lets you control both Spidey and Venom, who have wildly different gameplay styles, with the symbiote being a proper brute designed to embrace chaos.

Look, Ultimate Spider-Man is way too short to be really described as a fantastic game, but it's an absolute blast while it lasts. The combat is basic but solid, the web-swinging is good but not quite on Spider-Man 2 's level, and the story is pretty great.

Lego City Undercover Is The Perfect GTA For Kids

Collect-A-Thon Done Right

  • Perfect for approximately 20 hours.
  • The second-best undercover cop story in this article, but it is closer than you would think.

Most open-world games are perfectly fine for children, but they are really designed with younger players in mind. As Grand Theft Auto is meant for older folks only (even if nobody sticks to that rule), the gaming world needs a family-friendly substitute that can prepare youngsters for San Andreas. Lego City Undercover is that game.

Honestly, labeling TT Fusion's open-world adventure as a "children's game" would be a disservice, as Lego City Undercover is for all ages . Everyone can enjoy its surprisingly gorgeous city, accessible puzzles, comedic tone, and unlockables. By the time it left the Wii U and debuted on popular systems, the game was very much old news, so it didn't quite get its full moment in the sun.

item.title: Can You Change FOV in Mistfall Hunter?
item.description:
Trying to figure out how to change the FOV in Mistfall Hunter to fix motion sickness or tight camera angles? You aren't the only player feeling boxed in during fast-paced PvP clashes. A narrow field of view makes tracking ambushes in dark dungeons or open fields much harder than it needs to be. Unfortunately, there isn't a way to adjust Mistfall Hunter's FOV currently. Let's break down everything you need to know about in-game camera settings, potential workaround tweaks, and whether developer support for an FOV slider is on the way.

Mistfall Hunter: Withered Knight Guide

The Withered Knight is one of the strongest classes in Mistfall Hunter, but it requires skill. Master its raw power with this guide!

By Lucas Simons

Can You Change FOV in Mistfall Hunter?

No, Mistfall Hunter does not currently feature a native FOV slider or field-of-view setting . As of the current build, players cannot manually widen their camera's perspective or adjust the camera distance from their character through the standard graphics or gameplay menus.

Because Mistfall Hunter is a third-person PvPvE extraction RPG, the developers have locked the field of view to ensure a uniform visual field for all players during competitive encounters. However, this fixed third-person angle has led to feedback from players experiencing motion sickness or feeling overly restricted during tight, close-quarters dungeon combat.

How to Improve Mistfall Hunter FOV

While there isn't a way to widen the FOV in Mistfall Hunter , players can instead tweak a few settings to improve their visibility.

  • Disable Motion Blur : Motion blur can distort the environment, enemies, and even other players while your character is in motion. Disabling it is the way to go if you want to prioritize gameplay over Mistfall Hunter's cinematic feel.
  • Adjust View Distance : Increasing view distance can load far-off areas better, which will prevent texture pop-ins and allow you to anticipate any character approaching your location more quickly.
  • Lower Shadow Quality : Lowering shadow quality will improve the clarity of in-game objects, as well as give you a well-needed performance boost on PC.
  • Try Ultrawide Resolutions : On the subject of PC, if you have an Ultrawide monitor or can override your current monitor's resolution, you can try running the game at Ultrawide (21:9) resolution, which can technically increase FOV in Mistfall Hunter .
  • Disable In-game Tutorials : The game showers players with tutorial pop-ups, both while you're at your base or farming resources in Hallowgrove.
  • Increase Camera Sensitivity : Whether you're playing on a mouse or a keyboard, it's important to increase your camera sensitivity and disable any smoothing filters.
  • Boost Brightness : Increasing the brightness slider will improve in-game clarity in general. Just make sure to avoid increasing it too much to the point everything looks overblown.
  • Enable Auto-Close Inventory : This is one of the gameplay settings that auto-closes the inventory when you're getting attacked. It's especially helpful when you're looting an enemy's body, and another enemy or a player attacks you.

Will Mistfall Hunter Get an FOV Slider in the Future?

Since Mistfall Hunter is still fresh out of the launch gates, player feedback regarding camera distance and motion sickness is actively being reviewed. The developer's addition of FOV sliders in third-person games usually comes down to competitive balancing, as widening the camera gives players a broader peripheral view during PvP fights.

However, given the high volume of community requests during previous playtests, it is likely that the developers may introduce a subtle camera distance toggle or FOV slider in Mistfall Hunter as part of a future patch. I will update this guide as soon as any official settings update drops.
